These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/deploys`

Queue a deploy, dry run or rollback

Queues the work for a worker and answers 202 with the deploy's id; poll it to see how it went. Needs `DEPLOY` on the environment. A CI token may queue only one deploy or dry run of its own repository and signed commit. Answers 404 when the environment or repository does not exist and 422 when the request is malformed or a rollback has no target.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `DeployCreate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repository` | text | yes |  |
| `kind` | one of `deploy`, `dry_run`, `rollback` | no |  |
| `ref` | text or null | no |  |
| `to_sha` | text or null | no |  |
| `to_previous` | true or false | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | Successful Response | `DeployAccepted` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `DeployAccepted`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `status` | text | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/deploys`

List an environment's deploys

Lists the deploy history, newest first, one page at a time, or in the order `sort` and `order` ask for: deploys of one state come newest first. The cursor of the next page is in the `X-Next-Cursor` response header and is absent on the last page; send the same `repository` and sort with every page. Needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the environment or repository does not exist and 422 for a `limit` below 1, an unknown `sort` or `order`, or a `cursor` this server did not issue for this list in this order.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `repository` | query | no | text or null | Only this repository's deploys. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most deploys returned (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `X-Next-Cursor` of the previous page. |
| `sort` | query | no | text or null | What the list is sorted by: `created` (the default) or `status`; deploys of one state come newest first. |
| `order` | query | no | text or null | `asc` or `desc`; by default `desc` for `created` (the newest first), `asc` for `status`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `DeployOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Needs `DEPLOY` or `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. A CI token can see only the deploys it queued. Answers 404 when the deploy does not exist in the environment.

## `PUT /api/v1/environments/{env}/deployments/{repo}/run-as`

Set the service account a deployment runs as

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Binds the service account whose rights the runs of this deployment use to write. Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the environment. Answers 404 when the environment, repository, deployment or service account does not exist (one message for a missing or non-service account) and 422 when the service account is deactivated.

## `DELETE /api/v1/environments/{env}/deployments/{repo}`

Remove a deployment

Removes the repository's deployment and its binding in the environment; the tables and data stay. Needs `DEPLOY` on the environment; a CI token is always refused. Answers 404 when the environment, repository or deployment does not exist, and 409 while a run, or a deploy or rollback, of the repository is queued or running there, and when the deployment is not at `expected_project_version_id` (optional: the project version the caller saw).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `repo` | path | yes | text | Repository name. |
| `expected_project_version_id` | query | no | text (uuid) or null | The project version the caller saw as current; omitted, whatever is current goes. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Successful Response | none |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/project-versions/{project_version_id}`

Show a project version

Shows the version's manifest, limited to what the caller may see. Needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the environment has no such project version.

An asset's or check's SQL is the text of a project file, so it is shown only under the rule of a table's "Defined in" file: to a reader of every table the file uses, with no row filter or column mask on any of them, for a file that reads no raw path or connection and that Lakana recorded at deploy. Every asset and check carries `content_reason` and `content_message`: both `null` when its SQL is shown, otherwise `restricted` or `not_recorded` and the sentence that says what to do. Each file shown is recorded in the audit log (`SOURCE_VIEWED`); when that fails, the answer is 503 and shows nothing.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `project_version_id` | path | yes | text (uuid) | The project version's id. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `ProjectVersionOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `503` | The server cannot do this right now; ask again after the time in `Retry-After`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `ProjectVersionOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `environment` | text | yes |  |
| `repository` | text | yes |  |
| `commit_sha` | text | yes |  |
| `code_uri` | text | yes |  |
| `code_sha256` | text | yes |  |
| `deployed_by` | text (uuid) or null | yes |  |
| `created_at` | text (date-time) | yes |  |
| `manifest` | mapping of text to any | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/orphans`

Lists the tables that earlier project versions produced and the current ones do not, including dropped ones that can still be restored (`exists` is false). Needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the environment does not exist and 422 for a cursor this list did not issue.

## `GET /api/v1/deploys`

List the deploys of every environment you may read

Without `environment`, lists the deploys of every environment where you hold `READ_ENVIRONMENT`, newest first, in one list. An environment you may not read is left out, so this is never a 403 or a 404. With `environment`, it answers exactly what `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/deploys` answers, with its 403 and 404, in this body. Each deploy names its `environment`; `jobs` is `null` here, read one deploy for it. Send `next_cursor` back as `cursor` with the same `repository` and sort for the next page; `sort` and `order` order the list as on the list of one environment, and a cursor of that list is refused with 422 here. Answers 404 when `repository` does not exist and 422 for a `limit` outside 1 to 200, an unknown `sort` or `order`, or a `cursor` this server did not issue for this list in this order.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | query | no | text or null | Only this environment. |
| `repository` | query | no | text or null | Only this repository's deploys. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Page size (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |
| `sort` | query | no | text or null | What the list is sorted by, with the fields of the list of one environment. |
| `order` | query | no | text or null | `asc` or `desc`, each field's way by default, as on the list of one environment. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `DeployPageOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `DeployPageOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | list of `DeployOut` | yes |  |
| `next_cursor` | text or null | yes |  |
